text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's Enjoy☆Barbecue!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and Hishi Akebono invited 
the students to a barbecue, so I came 
along with K.S. Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"They say at this resort, you can catch 
fish with your bare hands and grill them 
to eat♪ Let's catch a whole bunch and have 
a blast!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, seeing everyone and Trainer having 
fun... makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, crazy!! There's a massive fish!! 
It's like three normal fish combined?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "W-Wah...! You're right, it's huge...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ain't no way I can just leave that be☆ All 
right, let's do this—!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaarrrrgh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaargh~~~~~... Whoa... So faaast. I 
can't keep up at allll...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Helios-senpai, you look totally 
exhausted. What's up?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, the truth is—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Is that the fish!? It really is super 
fast and huge~!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, this is a hero's cue! I'll go catch 
it for you! Leave it to me~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah... It's no use at all... She's way 
faster than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right!? Being big and fast is just too 
overwhelmingly strong~~!!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...They both look frustrated. —Alright.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll go. I don't know if I can do it, 
but— I'll give it my all."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahâ!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh... Faster than I expected...
choice_data_list: If I can just get a little more speed...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes, just a little more...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I won't lose when it comes to speed. 
Not to anyone—not even to a fish—!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! Everyone is so full of festive 
hype~♪ Did something good happen?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: A strategy... I see.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Right. Maybe we can drive it toward that 
rock. Let me try!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! Everyone is so full of festive 
hype~♪ Did something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Miracle's in the middle of fightin' a 
giant fish! Like, we gotta cheer 'em on, 
no cap!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Buono☆ If that's the case, we'll cheer you 
on too~~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san!! Fiiiiiiight!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ――! Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...I won't let all this cheering go to 
waste!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahâ!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*flop, flop flop!!*)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew— I managed to catch it safely...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Aweeeeesome!! I for real caught 
it~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's all thanks to your cheering. 
...I'm so glad I got to see everyone's 
smiles.
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see you smiling too.
I'm happy to see you smiling too

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we grilled and ate the fish we 
caught. The big fish K.S. Miracle caught 
was delicious.
